status_semantics.active: Current user-facing development; tests are still required.
status_semantics.maintained: Supported bounded surface; does not imply release certification.
status_semantics.experimental: Research or draft work; claims require specific evidence.
status_semantics.archived: Historical source retained in place; not a default execution path.
status_semantics.dormant: Prototype lacks current execution evidence; revival needs explicit acceptance criteria.
